clips.title: The story
paras: Near Stonewatch Keep, Marshal Marris puts a bounty on Tharil'zun, whose outrunners harass the roads. His death is a critical step in breaking the Blackrock clan's hold over northern Redridge, and his severed head brought to Lakeshire marks a hard-fought victory for its watch.

The pass between Lakeshire and Stonewatch Keep has become a gauntlet of sudden ambushes. Blackrock outrunners and renegades prowl the rocky ridges, cutting off scouts and threatening reinforcements trying to reach the fortress. Marshal Marris names Tharil'zun as the commander behind these coordinated strikes. He says Tharil'zun must be eliminated, or Lakeshire may be hemmed in entirely.

Tharil'zun is a dangerous battlefield leader: vicious, crafty, and able to unite scattered orc raiders into an effective raiding force. To take his head in Stonewatch's shadow, you must cut through entrenched Blackrock outposts. His death breaks the outrunner patrols' cohesion and clears a path for the Alliance to face the garrison inside the keep.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep. The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc. Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense. But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc. Well done--I'm sure he didn't go down easy. Here is your reward, friend.
